record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A joint release announces a national lab providing security and safety testing of AI models, agents and applications as a certification and conformance service for organisations.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English searches found a specific July 2025 MBRSG brief advocating a UAE AISI. The retrieved full PDF identifies the authors as MBRSG researchers and explicitly states that their views need not represent the school's trustees, officers, staff or associated entities (printed p.13). This resolves the brief as author advocacy rather than verified government commitment, formal government proposal or commissioned government exploration. The existing National AI Test and Validation Lab's deployed-system certification remit was not expanded by new primary evidence. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Retrieved the government announcement of the Artificial Intelligence and Data Authority as new primary governance evidence. Raised confidence to medium under the status-confidence rule: recorded queries in English and a national or official language, and cited primary governance evidence consistent with no qualifying institute. check.language_note: The recorded ar query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English and Arabic; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The regional Arcadia abstract does not supply a retrieved country-specific institutional excerpt independently corroborating the national lab account. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: The June 2026 announcement creates the Artificial Intelligence and Data Authority as the single national body for data, AI and digital government, reporting to the Cabinet; its listed functions cover strategy, policy, standards and compliance across federal entities, not evaluation of advanced models. The Cyber Security Council's National AI Test and Validation Lab tests, validates and certifies models, agents and applications for security, safety and trustworthiness; its classification is set out in the closest-candidate note.

related_bodies.name: National AI Test and Validation Lab
related_bodies.role: It is a certification lab for AI models, agents and apps, governed by the UAE Cyber Security Council and operated with Cisco and Open Innovation AI (May 2026).

related_bodies.name: Cyber Security Council
related_bodies.role: It governs the test lab. It is a federal cyber security body.

related_bodies.name: Federal Authority for Artificial Intelligence and Data
related_bodies.role: Policy, legislation, standards and compliance are its announced responsibilities. The June 2026 announcement says it brings together the functions previously held by the AI office, the digital government sector of the telecommunications regulator and the UAE Data Office; no testing mandate was found.

next_check.reason: Whether the National AI Test and Validation Lab takes on evaluation of advanced models.

record.notes: The lab is government-governed and offers what it calls sovereign, independent evaluation, but its remit is security conformity certification of deployed systems for government and business, without a separately identified qualifying capability or behaviour-risk assignment. Khaleej Times reported on 6 October 2026 that an adviser to the UAE President, speaking at a conference in Abu Dhabi, said countries should build independent systems for testing increasingly powerful models; no qualifying institute announcement was identified.

closest_body.name: National AI Test and Validation Lab
closest_body.note: A joint release announces the government-governed lab for security, safety and trustworthiness testing and certification of models, agents and applications, including continuous red-teaming. Its listed evaluations include risks of agent tool-use, but the release presents the service as policy conformance and verification against security standards for organisations, without identifying a qualifying national evaluation role. The government news-agency copy was unreadable.

claims.text: The press release describes a collaboration to establish the UAE's National AI Test and Validation Lab to provide "sovereign, independent assessment and certification for AI models, agents, and applications".
